Questions And Answers Of GTBET9


*Which Currency Only Accept?

  • AUD - Australian Dollar
  • Payment Getaways Methods


*How To Create An Account?

  • You need to have Australian Phone Number.
  • Bank Account, BSB Number, PayID under your name.
  • To get started, simply click the "REGISTER" button on our homepage, you will receive the verification code to your phone number. Once registered, you can easily top up your account by clicking "DEPOSIT" or withdraw your funds by clicking "WITHDRAW".


*What should I Do If I Can't Receive The Verification Code?

  • To register a new user or reset a password if you've forgotten it, you need to request a verification code.
  • Please use the active and valid phone number for registration.
  • The maximum limit request for verification code is only 3 times per day.
  • If exceeded max limits per day, must wait after 24 hours.
  • Make sure your phone number is active and able to receive SMS.
  • Take Note: we cannot help you for registration or get the OTP verification code.
  • For security reasons, users can contact our customer service for clarification.


*Can I Register Multiple Accounts?

  • Multiple account registration is strictly prohibited. Any violation of this policy will result in account restrictions and the forfeiture of associated benefits.


*What Are The Deposit And Withdrawal Limits?

  • The minimum deposit amount is AUD 10 and the minimum withdrawal amount is AUD 30 (excluding applied bonuses).
  • Deposits play SLOT Require A x1.0 Rollover on the Total Bet.
  • Deposits play LIVE Require A x1.0 Rollover on the Total Bet.


*If I Still Have A Balance, Can I Make Another Deposit?

  • To avoid confusion in bonus rules, you should play and wager your points after each deposit and bonus acquisition. Once your points go below AUD0.50 or after withdrawal, you can submit the deposit again.
  • Noted: Before you submit your next Deposit, please click “Clear Balance” first, make sure your credit does not combine with other bonuses, because it will affect your withdrawal limit.


*What Is Our Rollover, Turnover, And Winover?

  • Different companies have different abbreviations and rules, but in our company, there are only Rollover, Turnover, and Winover. Follow the instructions below:
  • ROLLOVER: Total Bet Of Your Credit In The Game = (Deposit Amount).
  • TURNOVER: Minimum Withdraw / Final Remain Credit or Total Bet Of Your Credit In The Game = (Deposit + Bonus).
  • WINOVER: Total win of your credit (Deposit + Bonus).


*Can I Combine Multiple Bonuses At The Same Time?

  • No, you cannot apply for multiple promotions, free credit, bonuses, refunds, commissions, angpao and etc., at the same time.
  • While you might sometimes be able to activate various bonuses, this overrides withdrawal rules across different bonuses. Once the rules are violated, the bonus will be forfeited.


*Why Do Gaming Platforms Sometimes Disappear?

  • To provide a better and more different gaming environment, some gaming platforms occasionally undergo maintenance.
  • During the maintenance period, the gaming platform will be temporarily removed with the credit from the website, and once the repairs are completed, the gaming platform will be placed back with the credit on the website.


*What Should I Do If My Credits Disappear During Game Maintenance?

  • During game maintenance, your credits will be held within the game until the maintenance is completed, at which point your scores will be restored.


*I've Met The Rollover Requirements, Why Can’t I Withdraw?

  • The deposit when requesting a bonus will have rollover requirements. Once you complete the rollover requirements, please exit the game completely and give the system some time to update the rollover progress bar.
  • Once the rollover progress bar is complete, withdrawals can be made.


*Verify Withdrawal Rules

  • You can view the rules of this game below the "Balance" section in the Wallet.
  • If you were claim some bonus, you can check in Bonus Details.

  • On our website or app, scroll down and locate the "COPY REFERRAL LINK" option, then click on it.
